sentences.text: Suppose size runs from 300 to 2,000 square feet and bedrooms from 0 to 5.

sentences.text: Terrible.

w1 equals 0.1, w2 equals 50, b equals 50 predicts 0.1 times 2000 plus 50 times 5 plus 50 equals 500, which is $500k.

sentences.text: Right.

sentences.text: So a feature with a big range ends up with a small weight, and a feature with a small range ends up with a big weight.
sentences.say: So a feature with a big range ends up with a small weight, and a feature with a small range ends up with a big weight.
